is the most innovative cooling solution that provides the most efficient thermal
performance for the graphics card.

Monitor connection instruction
1. Outputs are automatically detected when the
PC is restarted, no further setup is required.
2. If the A1 area and the A2 area are each
connected to the display at the same time, the A1 area will not be activated.
3. If the graphics card output is changed from
A1 to A2 or from A2 to A1, you must restart the computer to complete the switch.
4. The GPU supports up to 4 different views.
